summary: Ran full backend pytest suite (5 tests) and comprehensive Playwright checks across all 7 pages on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Backend endpoints (POST/GET /api/inquiries) work and validation returns 422 for empty name/contact. Frontend: hero, stone erosion, count-up stats (3 / 120+ / 340), scroll-reveal headings, testimonial-rail, pedestal-rail (Transformations), 4 compare-* sliders, coaching FAQ (open/close), package prices ₹4,500 / ₹9,800 / ₹24,000, mobile hamburger overlay, WhatsApp float (wa.me/919876543210) and Instagram (@aarav.chisel) links all verified. Inquiry form submits successfully end-to-end to MongoDB and shows inquiry-success. Empty submit shows toast and does not submit. No horizontal overflow on any page at desktop or mobile. No console/pageerror JS errors detected.

minor.issue: Response returns `_id` field instead of `id`. FastAPI serializes the Inquiry response_model with by_alias=True by default, so the alias `_id` (used for Mongo binding) leaks to the API contract. Task requirement is 'returns 200 with an id'. Fix: in the endpoint return `inquiry.model_dump(by_alias=False)` or change the alias approach (e.g., use a separate response model without `_id` alias, or `Field(alias='_id', serialization_alias='id')`). Also affects GET /api/inquiries list items.

action_items: Fix Inquiry response serialization so POST /api/inquiries and GET /api/inquiries return `id` (string) instead of `_id`. Recommended: use a distinct response model or serialization_alias='id' with by_alias=False.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined after create_inquiry uses it. Currently works (called at request time after module init) but move logger init above route definitions for clarity.
server.py: Inquiry model conflates the DB alias `_id` with the API response field, resulting in `_id` being exposed to clients. Separate DB representation from API response schema.

server.py: created_at stored as ISO string rather than datetime — makes sort('created_at', -1) rely on lexicographic ordering which happens to work for ISO-8601 UTC but is fragile; prefer datetime type.
server.py: No length/format validation on name/contact/message (any whitespace-only goal/experience accepted). Consider Pydantic constraints (min_length, EmailStr/regex for contact).

Lenis smooth scroll means for count-up you should use `element.scroll_into_view_if_needed()` and wait 2-3s, not window.scrollTo.
rca of the issue: POST /api/inquiries returning `_id` instead of `id`: FastAPI's response serialization of the Inquiry Pydantic model uses `by_alias=True` by default when a response_model is set. The `id` field is aliased to `_id` for MongoDB round-tripping, so the alias leaks into the JSON response. Mitigation: (a) return a plain dict/response model without the `_id` alias, or (b) use pydantic v2 `Field(alias='_id', serialization_alias='id')`, or (c) set `response_model_by_alias=False` on the route decorator.
